# Bring Your Broken Toaster. Stay for Coffee.

## Fix-It Saturday at St. Ansgar

**Saturday, December 5, 2026**  
**9 a.m.–1 p.m.**  
Fellowship Hall, St. Ansgar Lutheran Church  
Minneapolis, Minnesota  
Enter through the alley door; a ramp is available.

Our first Fix-It Saturday is coming to St. Ansgar, and the whole neighborhood is invited.

Bring something that needs fixing, and our volunteer fixers will do their best to help. So far, we have people ready to work on small appliances, lamps, bikes and clothing, plus someone to sharpen knives and a retired tech guy who can help with laptops and phones.

The idea started in the church kitchen, when Marv Okafor fixed my 1970s Hamilton Beach mixer in twenty minutes. Too much gets thrown away that just needs a screw or a new cord. Why not get our neighbors together and see what we can mend?

Doris Lindqvist, 84, has been darning socks for this parish since the Carter years, and she asked to run the mending table herself. I’m delighted she will.

Fix-It Saturday is **free and open to everyone**. You don’t have to be a church member, and there’s no need to sign up. Donations to the food shelf are welcome but not expected. Please bring one item per person to start, so we can keep the line moving.

And don’t just drop off that broken toaster and leave. Stay for coffee and kringle! This is good neighboring, plain and simple: no strings, and nobody will preach at you.

After December 5, we’ll gather on the first Saturday of every month through spring.

**Want to help fix things?** We’d love more volunteer fixers, especially people who know their way around vacuums or zippers. Contact the church office at **office@stansgarlutheran.example** or **612-555-0148**.
